before.manufacturerDetails:
Description
An expandable bottom compartment accommodates more mission-critical gear.

Details
We carefully consider what is put in each of our bags and tailor the compartments, pockets and other features to make sure there is a perfect place for everything. Sometimes you need more space, while other times you need less. This bag expands to accommodate both. The coated 210 ripstop nylon and polyurethane zippers provide extra protection and water resistance. Includes an adjustable mounting system to fit most any bike.

Key Features
ORGANIZATION — We carefully consider what is put in each of our bags and tailor the compartments, pockets and other features to make sure there is a perfect place for everything.
EXPANDABLE — Sometimes you need more space, while other times you need less. This bag expands to accommodate both.
HOSE PORT — Outpost Elite frame bags feature a hose port to allow for the storage of a water reservoir and/or a cache battery to get dense, heavy products to the lowest center of gravity.
WATER RESISTANT — Coated 70d ripstop nylon and polyurethane zippers provide extra protection against the elements.
ADJUSTABLE MOUNTING — Bikes come in a lot of shapes and sizes. This bag includes adjustable mounting systems to allow fitment to almost any bike.
LIFETIME WARRANTY —

description.ru: Сумка на верхнюю трубу Rockgeist объёмом 0.8 / 1.1 / 1.4 L. Характеристики нормализованы по официальной карточке товара.

before.manufacturerDetails:
**Update: This bag is taking a break and we are not making it at this time. As a small, made-in-USA manufacturer it’s sometimes challenging to offer such a diverse product range. At the moment, we are rebuilding our workshop from a flood and are focusing our efforts on our core expertise; custom framebag and waterproof bag options. It’s unlikely this offering will come back anytime soon, but you can still sign up for the in-stock alert. Thank you for your understanding.
Stable, accessible storage with electronic cord access. Comes with 1/4″ Dog Bone Spacer but please note the  Spacelink  is sold separately.
Features that make this bag great 
Electronic cord access ( e.g ., headphones, dynamo cords)
1-handed opening/closing when riding
Dog-bone foam spacer at stem
Glow-in-the-dark zipper pull
Rubberized bottom webbing to prevent rotating off the top tube
Connect to our Spacelink for enhanced stability and clean aesthetics
All Ultra PE fabrics (aka dyneema, EPL, Cuben Fiber) are +$10 to the base price. These fabrics have especially high strength to weight ratio.

description.en: Gondola Dropper Post Saddlebag is a Rockgeist saddle bag in 3 / 4 L. Technical data is normalized from the official product page.
description.ru: Подседельная сумка Rockgeist объёмом 3 / 4 L. Характеристики нормализованы по официальной карточке товара.

before.manufacturerDetails:
Gondola is a lightweight saddlebag with full dropper post compatibility. Please see the Fabric page for color and material descriptions. Upgrade to aluminum Austere cam buckles for exceptional stability and sag-free performance when riding your most technical trails (made to order fabric required, not able to be put on in-stock bags).
What makes the Gondola great:
Maintains full range of your dropper travel
Does not require additional clamps or brackets
AXS compatible (wireless dropper post)
Lightweight and stable to excel on singletrack
Gondola Dropper Pack Install
Our Gondola dropper pack uses an uncoventional webbing set up around the rails of your saddle. This video is a quick way to learn the install and ensure your have your Gondola set up properly.

before.name: Microwave Panniers (pair)

description.en: Microwave Panniers (pair) is a Rockgeist pannier in 13 / 26 L. Technical data is normalized from the official product page.
description.ru: Панир Rockgeist объёмом 13 / 26 L. Характеристики нормализованы по официальной карточке товара.

before.manufacturerDetails:
Microwave Panniers are a from-scratch rethinking of the traditional micro panniers. Modular, ultra-secure, truly waterproof, and super light, they are equally suited to riding rough trails as they are to urban living.
The two-part system includes a quick-access drybag and a rugged holster that secures to any rack. The stiff, black HDPE back plate uses Voilé Straps® for upper mounting that can’t move in any direction. Five options for lower mounting keeps these totally rattle-free.
